## Patch round — the file is at 73, one line above the ceiling

Verdict was REWORK with one item: bring `references/lanes/director.md` back to 72 / 72. It now reads **73**. The compression landed in full; the deletion side could pay only one of the two lines it was asked for, and the second candidate is reported here rather than cut, because cutting it would have dropped a rule with no surviving home.

### 1. The three added lines are now two

Both sit under the 120-byte per-line cap the ratchet reads. Described rather than quoted — the landed bytes carry the corpus's angle-bracket placeholders, spelled here as words per the body-sanitizer rule:

| line | bytes | carries |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | 109 B | 录裁同笔改正文 — the body's first line takes the literal `Ruled:` plus the ruling comment id, the letter and the UTC stamp; then ⛔ 不新增标签与状态 |
| L2 | 119 B | 划掉原 ⛔ 不派断言 — the strike; the `post-stamped --body --ack-through` route; 漏此笔 ⇒ 接卡者先读正文退决策箱 — the failure mode and its named reader |

⚠️ **The element split in the patch order does not fit the cap, and this was measured, not assumed.** The order put the strike on L1 beside the act, the spelling and the no-new-label guard; that L1 measures **132 B** against the 120 B cap, while its L2 sits at 99 B with 21 B unused. Every spelling of that split was searched — two act phrasings, two strike phrasings, four route phrasings and four failure phrasings, 64 combinations across three element layouts — and **zero** pairs fit. The one layout that fits moves the strike down to L2. No element the order named was dropped: act, spelling, no-new-label-or-state, strike, route and failure mode are all present, and L1's 录裁同笔改正文 is what binds the strike on L2 into the same stroke.

### 2. Retired: one line, with the line that now carries its substance

| retired, verbatim | surviving home, verbatim |
|---|---|
| `- 裁决仍被尊重但非放行必要条件,⛔ 不与席内复核抢同一载体的放行动作。` | `- 本职是审计位,非放行链:放行常设归派发席席内复核,归属与全链见 ../contract-review.md。` (the line directly above it) |

Both halves land there. 「非放行必要条件」 follows from 「非放行链:放行常设归派发席席内复核」 — clearance being the in-seat review's standing duty is exactly what makes a director ruling not a precondition for it; the same fact is stated a second time in 授权与形态 (「复核放行不在其内,常设归派发席席内」) and a third time in the file that line points at, where the director's ruling is declared 非达档裁决. 「⛔ 不与席内复核抢同一载体的放行动作」 follows from 「本职是审计位,非放行链」 — a seat that is not in the clearance chain takes no clearance action. The remaining fragment, 「裁决仍被尊重」, is the concessive half of the sentence and places no obligation on anyone.

Nothing pins the retired text: `grep -rn` for both of its distinctive phrases across `.claude/` and `scripts/` returns the charter line itself and nothing else. Its status as a restatement is independently on the record — the ratchet's own ceiling commentary names 非放行必要条件 as a measured restatement in a sibling file, rejected as payment there only because trimming it saved bytes without removing a whole line. Here it is a whole line, so it banks one.

Augmenting the surviving line was considered and rejected on measurement: it stands at 116 B, and appending 「⛔ 不抢放行动作」 would take it to 141 B, past the cap.

### 3. NOT retired, and why — the second candidate

`- 到合并 = 推进到就绪并点名等待,⛔ 不代维护者合并。`

The condition for retiring it was that **both** halves are provably already stated. Only one is.

- 「⛔ 不代维护者合并」 — yes, stated: 「批准与合并恒是维护者的点击,⛔ 不代。」 in 职责二.
- 「到合并 = 推进到就绪并点名等待」 — **no surviving home.** This is the definition of the term the line above it uses (「跟到合并为止」). `grep -rn` for 推进到就绪 and for 点名等待 across the whole pm-dispatch tree and the dev-agent definition returns this line and nothing else. The nearest candidate, `core-rules.md`'s 「跟到合并为止并每轮读队列成员资格与 origin/main」, defines the follow-through as polling the queue and main each round — not as stopping at ready and naming who is waited on.

Deleting it would leave 「收尾 PASS 且工已完 ⇒ 跟到合并为止」 undefined at the exact point where the misreading is "so merge it" — the reading Prime Directive #14 and #15 exist to prevent. Per 「砍掉内容若在别处无家,砍掉就是丢规则」, it stays.

### 4. Where that leaves the count

72 ceiling · 73 lines · **shortfall exactly 1 line**. The ratchet script was not touched and nothing further was deleted, per the patch order. The gate union was re-run on head `f411f58`: 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 15 green and `check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 1 on that one line. Tier unchanged: GOVERNED, Tier S, this PR stays DRAFT.

## Contract review

- Published accept set / public surface: none moves — one governed prose file (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md`, +2 / −2, 72 / 72 with the ceiling row untouched); no script, no label, no state. `check-governed-merges --pr 19303`: GOVERNED, Tier S (席内达档复核落地), 4 changed lines. Judged correct.
- The defect (#19256): a ruling recorded as a COMMENT left the card BODY asserting the opposite (「⛔ 不派」), and nothing reconciled them — measured at 11 and 15 days on two live cards. The fix is the procedure's missing step, in the 授权与形态 section beside the ruling-comment line it extends: 「录裁同笔改正文:首行加 `Ruled: <评论 id> · letter <X> · <UTC>`;⛔ 不新增标签与状态。」 (109 B) and 「划掉原 ⛔ 不派断言,走 `post-stamped --body --ack-through`;漏此笔 ⇒ 接卡者先读正文退决策箱。」 (119 B) — the banner names the comment that rules, the letter and the time; the body's contrary assertion is struck in the same act through the stamped body writer; and the failure mode is closed from the reader's side (a taker reads the body first and returns the card to the decision box). ⛔ No new label, no new state, per the card's own boundary. Judged correct.
- Payment on a zero-slack file, both lines provable duplicates with surviving homes: round 1 retired :29 「裁决仍被尊重但非放行必要条件,⛔ 不与席内复核抢同一载体的放行动作。」 (home: :27 「本职是审计位,非放行链:放行常设归派发席席内复核」); round 2 — the seat's own decision, ⛔ no ceiling raise — retired :22 「呈报批序与写法见 `../decision-analysis.md`。」, a pure pointer whose two referents survive: the 写法 pointer at 职责二 「有席内 ACCEPT 者呈一批 ≤5 行,写法见 `../decision-analysis.md`」 (the only other pointer to that file in the charter), and 批序 as that file's own content (`decision-analysis.md` :13 「批序:在飞被阻塞 > 运营阻塞 > 用户可见 > 结构性」); nothing pins the retired text (grep over `.claude/` and `scripts/`: the line itself only). Judged correct.
- Evidence, dev-run on this head and seat-read on the diff: `check-skill-line-ratchet` exit 0 (「director.md is 72 lines (ceiling 72; headroom 0)」, widest line 119 B); `check-skill-id-lint` / `check-governed-prose` exit 0; the derived union re-run on `daacc87`: 17 / 17 exit 0 with `--ran` reconciled (a DERIVED zero; `check:gitlink-declared` newly derived and run); the branch is merged up to `c334ba0`; the three-dot change set is exactly 1 file. CI on `daacc87` at the seat's read: 25 check runs, 4 still running, 0 red — the flip waits for them.

### ② Semver level

None — nothing published; `skip-changeset` on the PR is the correct declaration. Judged correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions` empty. Deviations read and accepted: the seat's patch order said 「commit with the card trailer」 and the dev correctly followed AGENTS.md and the pre-push gate instead (a card relation's only carrier is the PR body; the trailer pair is model-free) — the order was the seat's slip, the dev's reading is right; `origin/main` moved under the shared worktree refs (a two-dot diff shows main's own files; the three-dot set is authoritative); the build refresh stayed narrowed to `@objectstack/lint`'s closure for a two-line markdown change. Two `noted, not filed` items: 「到合并 = 推进到就绪并点名等待」 is the charter's last pointer-shaped line and is NOT a compression candidate (its definition half has no other home — recorded so no future ceiling round re-measures it; 承接者 PM); the `Ruling:` (comment) vs `Ruled:` (body banner) spelling asymmetry is intentional. Seat reading: #19274 (p1) lands in the same charter next, hard-serial behind this PR under 甲; it will need its own retirements and reads this PR's two homes as taken.
